label: GFREAD IGES into an object with 8 curves

inputs.name: CMD.KEY
inputs.text:
KFREAD
IN.KEY
GFREAD 9
CIRC.IGS
KFWRIT
OUT.KEY

expect.notes: Object 9 has 8 curves in geometry 0 (DIEGEO 9 1 33, 7 separators). The IGES pass sets the curve count to 1 (140198230 -> 14027fe20 -> 140280290 removes edges 1..7, renumbers), then stores the arc in curve 0.
